authority.note: A mutated passage hash must be rejected before a decision.
A well-formed substituted source hash is not bound to passage bytes. A decision here is a gap, not support.
A relation from one evidence world must not compose in another.
A child text hash that does not match the declaration is stale.
A missing declared child must fail.
An undeclared child result must fail.
A copied child result id must fail verification.
A declaration whose child sequence is not 1..n must fail.
Supply order of a commutative all_of does not change the conclusion. The declared sequence still binds.
An empty Contract B version must fail.
Unknown aperture keys are not a closed schema on the audit seam. Acceptance is a gap.
A checkout that is not the pinned Contract C candidate must fail.
A checkout that is not the pinned resolver must fail.
The pinned Contract C, RC2, and resolver checkouts must verify. Unavailable checkouts block only this control.
A candidate module whose semantic identity is not caa0048f must fail before emission.

operational.note: Two callers on one pre-filled output directory must both be refused. Acceptance is a critical overwrite.
Two callers on one empty directory. The destination helper does not take a lock. Both accepting is an interface gap. Both rejecting is a stronger PASS.
